headline: 49ers beat the Commanders 23-17 and move to 6-0
whyCareReason: San Francisco stayed unbeaten on Monday night. Washington fell to 1-4-1. Thursday is Patriots at Bears.
teaser: Levi's Stadium final: Commanders 17, 49ers 23. Purdy threw for 264 yards. McCaffrey ran for two scores.
story: Monday night at Levi's Stadium finished Washington Commanders 17, San Francisco 49ers 23. Quarters were Commanders 3, 0, 7, 7 and 49ers 13, 7, 3, 0. ESPN and the Associated Press both list the final. Brock Purdy completed 21 of 29 passes for 264 yards and a touchdown, an 11-yard score to George Kittle. Christian McCaffrey had two rushing touchdowns, 16 carries for 64 yards and nine catches for 53 yards. Jayden Daniels completed 29 of 40 passes for 300 yards and two touchdowns. San Francisco led 20-3 at halftime and 23-3 late in the third quarter. The 49ers are 6-0. The Commanders are 1-4-1. FOX Sports listed the crowd at 71,561.
stakes: San Francisco is the NFL's only 6-0 team. The Chiefs and Vikings are 5-0. Week 7 opens Thursday in Chicago.
rivalryAngle: An NFC Monday night that the visitors closed to 23-17 after trailing 23-3.
funFacts: Purdy 21 of 29 for 264 and a TD. McCaffrey two rushing TDs. Daniels 29 of 40 for 300 and two TDs.
Thursday 22 October, 8:15 p.m. ET: Patriots at Bears, Soldier Field, Prime Video. No score.
